ic.q.leverage: Leverage is {leverage}. One bad year of EBITDA and we trip the covenants. Can you justify this debt?
ic.q.price: That is {premium} against our own valuation. Why pay it?
ic.q.interest_cover: Interest cover is only {cover}. What happens if rates go up once more?
ic.q.no_financial_dd: No financial diligence and we are to trust the numbers? Who checked inventory and receivables?
ic.q.no_commercial_dd: Nobody has tested customers or the market. What backs the growth case?
ic.q.no_operational_dd: Nobody has walked the plant. We would buy without knowing the state of the equipment?
ic.q.no_legal_dd: Legal diligence is missing. Contracts, litigation, permits?
ic.q.inventory_days: Inventory days run long for the industry. Can we take the inventory on the books at face value?
ic.q.thin_returns: The base case IRR is {irr}. That is below our hurdle.
ic.q.multiple_reliance: Growth is industry average and the price is a premium. Does this only work if the multiple expands at exit?
ic.q.downside: If EBITDA falls by a fifth this debt does not hold. Have you run the downside?
ic.q.no_plan: The 100-day plan is empty. What do we do on day one?
ic.q.layoffs_in_union_shop: The plan cuts heads in a shop that is {union} unionized. Who answers for the strike?
ic.q.fund_concentration: Equity of {equity} is over the per-deal limit of {limit}. What do we tell the LPs?
ic.q.open_issue: Diligence found {issues}. Is it in the price?
ic.q.exit: Who buys this from us in five years?
ic.q.value_creation: What changes at this company once we own it?
ic.q.cycle: We are in a {phase}. What happens to this company in a recession?
ic.a.leverage.evidence: Interest cover of {cover}: the cash flow carries the interest comfortably.
ic.a.leverage.concede: I will leave the room to raise in the final round unused.
ic.a.leverage.push_back: On today's lending terms this is market standard.
ic.a.price.evidence: The price is inside the outside adviser's range.
ic.a.price.concede: I will not raise the price in the final round.
ic.a.price.push_back: It is a competitive auction. Below this we do not win.
ic.a.interest_cover.evidence: Rate sensitivity is already in the model.
ic.a.interest_cover.concede: I will narrow the room to raise and carry less debt.
ic.a.interest_cover.push_back: Rates have peaked. They only go down from here.
ic.a.no_financial_dd.evidence: The IM ties to the audited accounts.
ic.a.no_financial_dd.concede: I will have the financial report in before we bid.
ic.a.no_financial_dd.push_back: Diligence costs too much for a company this size.
ic.a.no_commercial_dd.evidence: I called five of the top customers myself.
ic.a.no_commercial_dd.concede: I will finish commercial diligence before we bid.
ic.a.no_commercial_dd.push_back: We know this sector better than anyone.
ic.a.no_operational_dd.evidence: Capex has been steady for years.
ic.a.no_operational_dd.concede: I will finish the site visit before we bid.
ic.a.no_legal_dd.evidence: I have seen the registry and the main contracts.
ic.a.no_legal_dd.concede: I will finish legal diligence before we bid.
ic.a.inventory_days.evidence: Slow turns are normal for the trade.
ic.a.inventory_days.concede: Financial diligence will check the inventory before we bid.
ic.a.thin_returns.evidence: With the 100-day plan the IRR rises.
ic.a.thin_returns.concede: I will narrow the room to raise and protect the entry price.
ic.a.thin_returns.push_back: This deal is about the multiple of money, not IRR.
ic.a.multiple_reliance.evidence: The adviser's trading comparables support this price.
ic.a.multiple_reliance.concede: I will not raise the price in the final round.
ic.a.downside.evidence: With cover of {cover} it holds in the downside.
ic.a.downside.concede: I will narrow the room to raise and borrow less.
ic.a.no_plan.evidence: We will write the plan with management after closing.
ic.a.no_plan.concede: I will pay less and settle the plan after closing.
ic.a.layoffs_in_union_shop.evidence: I have already talked to the union.
ic.a.layoffs_in_union_shop.concede: I will price conservatively and lean less on the cuts.
ic.a.layoffs_in_union_shop.push_back: Without the cuts there is no return.
ic.a.fund_concentration.evidence: A co-investor brings us inside the limit.
ic.a.fund_concentration.concede: I will narrow the room to raise and write a smaller check.
ic.a.fund_concentration.push_back: Good deals deserve a big bet.
ic.a.open_issue.evidence: It is priced in: we are below the valuation midpoint.
ic.a.open_issue.concede: I will narrow the room to raise.
ic.a.open_issue.push_back: Every company has issues like this.
ic.a.exit.evidence: The market is good and growth beats the industry. Strategics will bid.
ic.a.exit.concede: I will assume an exit at the entry multiple.
ic.a.value_creation.concede: I will pay less and prove it in the execution.
ic.a.cycle.evidence: Cover of {cover} carries it through a recession.
ic.a.cycle.concede: I will narrow the room to raise and take less cycle risk.
ic.title: Investment committee
ic.verdict.approved: Approved. You may bid at this price.
ic.verdict.held: Held. Revise the offer and bring it back.
ic.verdict.rejected: Rejected. This deal needs a rethink.
ic.conditions: Condition: {streams} diligence done before the bid
ic.cut: Room to raise cut by {pct} points
ic.sitting: The committee is sitting. Three partners have questions.
ic.r.evidence.no: That is thin. It does not answer it.
ic.r.concede.yes: On that condition, fine. Minute it.
ic.r.concede.no: A condition alone is not enough.
ic.r.push_back.yes: …All right. I will trust your judgment.
ic.r.push_back.no: That is not an answer. I am against.
msg.committee_convened.title: {company}: IC meeting
msg.committee_convened.body: The committee is sitting. Answer its questions in the deal room.
msg.owner_considering.title: {company}: the owner is considering
msg.bank_feedback.title: {company}: the seller's bank
msg.bank_feedback.leading.price: You lead for now. Prices can move again in the final round.
msg.bank_feedback.leading.certainty: You lead. The seller values certainty of closing.
msg.bank_feedback.close.price: You are close to the lead. Price decides it.
msg.bank_feedback.close.certainty: It is close. The seller weighs certainty as much as price.
msg.bank_feedback.behind.price: You are well behind. Look at the price again.
msg.bank_feedback.behind.certainty: You are behind, but the relationship with the seller can close some of it.
block.owner_considering: The owner is considering the proposal.
error.condition_open: A report the IC asked for is not in yet.
talk.think.1: A good proposal. Let me talk it over with the family; you will hear from me in a month or two.
talk.think.2: I see the numbers. I will hear the accountant and the bank first, then give you an answer.
error.not_this_month: Only this month's releases and meetings can be called.
